transform: read validator source and classify what it validates versus GitHub provider semantics not represented in its checks

checks: bounded external catalyst allowlist and pins
observed_validator_scope.method: text/regex/token checks over workflow files; no GitHub Actions schema/parser execution

blindspots_observed: does not parse YAML into a semantic job graph
does not prove every needs target names an existing job
does not validate expression syntax or context legality
does not validate job-level uses/reusable-workflow semantics
does not validate local action metadata against GitHub's action schema
does not invoke GitHub's workflow parser/validator
does not observe repository/org Actions policy or provider-side validation diagnostics

evidence_boundary.workflow_contract_pass_does_not_mean: GitHub provider accepts and materializes every job in ci.yml

gap.missing_field: specific GitHub Actions semantic/schema rejection causing zero materialized jobs
gap.blocking_dependency: provider validation diagnostic not exposed by currently observed run/jobs surface
gap.evidence_needed: provider diagnostic or controlled minimal workflow reproducer isolating a semantic class
gap.falsifier: materialized generic-ci job under identical semantic surface or diagnostic proving a non-semantic cause
gap.next_probe: create an audit-only minimal diagnostic workflow that tests provider acceptance independently, then incrementally introduce validation-sensitive classes; do not modify production ci.yml
gap.closure_gate: reproducible minimal provider-side failure or explicit provider diagnostic

memory_projection.L: V7 orthogonal PASS -> V8 validator semantic blindspots enumerated
memory_projection.O: successful repository-local validator is bounded evidence, not provider semantic proof
memory_projection.T: ci.yml <-> workflow-contract.py <-> GitHub provider parser boundary

F_next: materialize an audit-only minimal diagnostic workflow to test GitHub provider acceptance without touching production ci.yml
